originals.name: Layered Plate Overlay
originals.idea: Armour is a texture overlay on a shared body, so a gear change is one texture rebuild. Row 15 gear dressing.
originals.keep: overlay per slot on one body; section toggles for pieces
originals.change: our own region set (separate pauldrons); our silhouette by toggles; our trim motif

originals.name: Six-Step Shine
originals.idea: Six rarity steps on slot border and name, with a sound stinger per step. Row 18 loot roll; loot fold-in.
originals.keep: six steps; border and name tint; ramp from plain to top step
originals.change: our step names and hues; per-step stinger (donor has none); pulse only on top two steps

originals.name: Magma Bloom Pool
originals.idea: A hazard pool with an animated emissive glow that blooms. Row 16 colour grade; zone data.
originals.change: our palette; our pulse pattern; damage from a zone data field

originals.name: Dusk Band Sky
originals.idea: Per-zone colour band by time of day, fog equal to horizon. Row 16.
originals.change: our band count and palette; our moon and star layout; our clouds

originals.name: Shore-Fade Lake
originals.idea: Depth fade makes water read as water. Row 16; zone data.
originals.keep: clear shallows; dark deep water; fade by depth
originals.change: our hue and foam pattern; per-biome shallows colour

originals.name: Crossfade Stingers
originals.idea: Two music players crossfade on a fixed tick, with a day and night pair per zone. Sound fold-in; row 12.
originals.keep: A/B crossfade; day and night pair per zone
originals.change: a combat-entry stinger; our own tracks; our fade length

originals.name: Read Zoom Minimap
originals.idea: Minimap zoom clamped to a fixed range, with the zone name shown. Row 14 HUD; hud-ui fold-in.
originals.change: our range; pinch zoom for touch

originals.name: Corpse Reclaim Clock
originals.idea: A visible timer on the death screen before the corpse can be reclaimed, so a loss has a known length. Row 17 death and respawn.
originals.keep: timer on death screen; spirit release first
originals.change: timer length as zone data; our death-screen layout
